d: Maria decides to have 38 homemade cakes at her reception and strong-arms her 8 sisters into baking them, including one who is about to give birth. Teary Sharon faces more mishaps and bemoans her lack of friends.
Monica shows off her trailer fabulous down-home style and tells her fiance a jaw-dropping secret. Maria's maid of honor is in hot water after dropping one of her 38 homemade wedding cakes.

Monica brawls at her bachelorette party, cries uncontrollably at the rehearsal, then shocks everyone with a bright red wedding dress! No-nonsense Tasha wants things her way -- no matter whom she offends or drives crazy.
Tasha's sibling rivalry leads to a physical shoving match with her sister. Denise is having her wedding aboard a yacht, but if she doesn't get her attitude in check, she might wind up overboard!

Tasha does not take it in stride when her wedding day is marred by a myriad of last-minute mishaps and delays. 23 year-old Stephani's materialistic, self-absorbed demeanor is offset only by her hair-trigger temper!
Carla wants peace between her friends after the big fight, Renee vents to her therapist about her ex-husband's unreliability, and Drita is sick of waiting for Lee to come home for good.
Drita worries about her daughters, Karen revisits her past as she begins work on her book, and Renee finds comfort with an unlikely source when Junior is swept up in a mass mob bust.

st: Do You Know Who I Am?
d: Carla struggles with single motherhood, Renee hosts a psychic party and decides to bury the hatchet with Drita, and a confrontation at a bar threatens Junior's temporary freedom.
The ladies enjoy a wild VIP party, Renee undergoes a painful beauty treatment, and Karen and Drita's long-simmering conflict over Lee finally erupts into a heated argument.
Drita does a glamorous photoshoot for Lee, Renee has a new business idea, and when the four women gather for a dinner party, their attempts at conflict resolution go disastrously awry.
The ladies make peace in the wake of the tumultuous dinner, Karen reunites with daughter Karina, Carla prepares for Joe's release from prison, and Drita urges Renee to try online dating.
Evelyn strengthens her friendship with Jennifer as she struggles through the final decision about her embryos, and Cece dredges up old drama at Malaysia's wig party.
Jennifer visits a fertility specialist, OG presses Kwame for a commitment, and things get messy when Tami organizes a retreat to help the ladies work through their drama.
Shaunie launches an investigation into rumors that Evelyn was sleeping with her ex, Cece and Byron set Malaysia up on a blind date, and Tami crosses a line in a confrontation.
Things get heated between Evelyn and Tami, Malaysia attempts to mend Kristen and Cece's relationship, and OG talks about her long-distance relationship with Kwame.
Jackie stars in a play and is nervous for opening night, the death of OG's brother brings her closer to a former foe, and tensions rise between the women at Jackie's play.
Jackie helps Reggie plan a proposal, Evelyn visits her family in Puerto Rico, Malaysia has a tough talk with her son, Jennifer goes to court, and Tami has second thoughts.
